title: Microsoft 365 Copilot connectors: full refresh of a custom connector's data source through Microsoft Graph
summary: The briefing accurately separates the planned full sync from today's documented item deletion and connection permissions. No blocking errors were found; the claim that adoption necessarily sits in connector code needs narrowing, and the item-count check should identify its beta-only property.

claims.claim: Microsoft plans a full refresh of custom connector data sources through Graph APIs for administrators and developers.
claims.quote: Admins and developers can do a full refresh or sync of their datasource for Custom Connectors using Graph APIs.

claims.quote: any items deleted in the source are automatically deleted during this full sync

claims.claim: The planned full sync removes the need for separate delete APIs for source deletions.
claims.quote: admins do not have to use separate delete APIs to do this.

claims.claim: The Copilot connector APIs are a way to build custom synced connectors.

claims.claim: Each ingested source item is represented as an externalItem.
claims.quote: Each item from your data source must be represented as an externalItem in Microsoft Graph with a unique item ID.

claims.claim: The item guide documents adding individual items with unique identifiers.
claims.quote: To add an item to the index, you create an externalItem. When you create an item, you assign a unique identifier in the URL.

claims.claim: The item guide documents updating individual items by their unique identifiers.
claims.quote: you can update its entry in the index by updating the externalItem, using the unique identifier assigned to the item when you created it.
